senses.definition: Hindmost; nearest the stern.
senses.example: the mizzen shrouds, sails, etc.

senses.definition: On a mizzenmast, the lowest sail
The aftmost mast on a ship having three masts; the third-tallest mast on a full-rigged ship.
The third-foremost mast on a ship having more than three masts.
The second mast of a ship having two masts where the second one is shorter, such as a ketch or yawl.
A fore-and-aft sail set on a mizzenmast.
senses.example: Six of the Krabben's massive tentacles had wrapped themselves around the mizzensail.

senses.definition: A framework and platform at the top of the lower mizzenmast of a sailing ship

senses.definition: The mast section below the topgallant and above the mizzenmast.

senses.definition: To rain in very fine drops.
Misty rain; drizzle.
A mist; a fine spray; a spattering.

But he knows he need never be in dread

senses.definition: To abscond, scram, flee.
senses.example: As long as George IV could reign, he reigned, and then he mizzled.

senses.definition: To yield.

Of rain: falling very finely; drizzling.
Of a day, weather conditions etc.: drizzly.
